item.title: Building a Production-Grade Go Backend: The Golang4U Architecture
item.description:
Introduction

When building Golang4U, the goal was clear: create a robust, scalable, and secure backend that serves as a real-world example of professional Go development. In this post, I’ll walk you through the architectural decisions, the tech stack, and how we structured our application to handle everything from authentication to content management.

The Tech Stack

1. The Core: Echo Framework
